references.why: 'The righteous shall live by faith' — the phrase Luther wrestled with; pasted verbatim from the OLCB («Abatuukirivu banaabeeranga balamu lwa kukkiriza»).

note: The only chapter:verse scripture is Romans 1:17, pasted verbatim from the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (which matches the shipped Luganda corpus). The hymn line ('A mighty fortress', Luther's paraphrase of Psalm 46), the Melanchthon deathbed prayer, 'Here I stand', 'Help me, Saint Anne', and 'We are beggars; this is true' are Luther's own words, translated as prose.
